 Wipro (NYSE:WIT) Shares Gap Up - What's Next?
 Written by MarketBeat October 16, 2026 Add As Preferred Source Share Share Share This Article Link copied to clipboard. Close 
 Image from MarketBeat Media, LLC. 
 Key Points
 Wipro shares opened higher , rising from $1.87 to $1.95 before settling near $1.935, despite mixed quarterly results.
 Revenue of $2.58 billion matched expectations, but adjusted EPS of $0.03 missed the $0.04 consensus, while weaker-than-expected third-quarter guidance increased growth concerns.
 Analyst sentiment remains strongly negative: CLSA, JPMorgan, and Weiss Ratings downgraded the stock, while MarketBeat reports a consensus “Strong Sell” rating and a $1.70 price target.
 Get every upgrade, downgrade, and earnings report on Wipro as it happens. Lock in MarketBeat All Access for $149 a year through October 30. 
 Wipro Limited ( NYSE:WIT - Get Free Report ) gapped up before the market opened on Friday. The stock had previously closed at $1.87, but opened at $1.95. Wipro shares last traded at $1.9350, with a volume of 2,207,471 shares traded. Get Wipro alerts: Sign Up Key Headlines Impacting Wipro
 Here are the key news stories impacting Wipro this week: 
 Positive Sentiment: Wipro reported quarterly revenue of $2.58 billion , broadly in line with analyst expectations, indicating that demand remained stable despite the company’s sluggish growth environment. Wipro announces results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 
 Positive Sentiment: Management highlighted continued investments in AI and related capabilities, which could support longer-term growth and help Wipro capture technology-spending opportunities as clients adopt generative AI. Wipro earnings call: AI bets amid sluggish growth 
 Neutral Sentiment: The company posted a 13.93% net margin and 15.40% return on equity , but investors remain focused on whether margin performance and AI spending can translate into faster revenue growth. Wipro reports second-quarter and six-month results 
 Negative Sentiment: Adjusted earnings were $0.03 per share , below the $0.04 analyst consensus. The miss reinforces concerns about profitability and contributed to the weaker investor reaction. Wipro earnings report 
 Negative Sentiment: Wipro’s third-quarter revenue outlook reportedly fell below market forecasts. The cautious guidance, combined with the earnings miss, is the main reason the stock decreased following the results. Wipro shares decline as third-quarter guidance falls below forecasts 
 Negative Sentiment: DBS maintained a Sell rating on Wipro, adding to the negative sentiment around the company’s growth outlook. DBS remains a Sell on Wipro 
 Wall Street Analyst Weigh In
 A number of equities analysts have recently weighed in on WIT shares. CLSA lowered Wipro from a "hold" rating to an "underperform" rating in a research note on Wednesday, August 19th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. lowered Wipro from a "neutral" rating to an "underweight" rating and decreased their price objective for the stock from $2.20 to $1.70 in a report on Wednesday, June 24th. Finally, Weiss Ratings lowered shares of Wipro from a "hold (c-)" rating to a "sell (d+)" rating in a research report on Friday, October 2nd. Four analysts have rated the stock with a Sell rating. According to data from MarketBeat, the stock presently has a consensus rating of "Strong Sell" and a consensus target price of $1.70.
 Check Out Our Latest Research Report on Wipro Wipro Stock Up 3.5%
 The company has a market capitalization of $19.14 billion, a P/E ratio of 14.89, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 4.11 and a beta of 0.97. The business has a 50 day moving average of $1.78 and a 200 day moving average of $1.97. 
 Wipro ( NYSE:WIT - Get Free Report ) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, October 15th. The information technology services provider reported $0.03 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, missing the consensus estimate of $0.04 by ($0.01). The business had revenue of $2.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts' expectations of $2.58 billion. Wipro had a net margin of 13.93% and a return on equity of 15.40%. On average, research analysts anticipate that Wipro Limited will post 0.14 EPS for the current year. Institutional Trading of Wipro
 Several large investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in WIT. Affinity Capital Advisors LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Wipro by 92.1% in the 3rd quarter. Affinity Capital Advisors LLC now owns 23,809 shares of the information technology services provider's stock worth $40,000 after acquiring an additional 11,417 shares during the last quarter. QRG Capital Management Inc. raised its holdings in shares of Wipro by 47.3% in the 2nd quarter. QRG Capital Management Inc. now owns 61,847 shares of the information technology services provider's stock valued at $139,000 after buying an additional 19,868 shares during the period. Tidal Investments LLC raised its holdings in shares of Wipro by 427.2% in the 2nd quarter. Tidal Investments LLC now owns 271,584 shares of the information technology services provider's stock valued at $611,000 after buying an additional 220,065 shares during the period. Engineers Gate Manager LP lifted its stake in Wipro by 241.0% during the 2nd quarter. Engineers Gate Manager LP now owns 706,130 shares of the information technology services provider's stock worth $1,589,000 after acquiring an additional 499,082 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Nykredit A S acquired a new position in Wipro during the 2nd quarter worth about $3,505,000. 2.36% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. About Wipro
 ( Get Free Report ) Wipro Limited NYSE: WIT is an India-based technology services and consulting company that helps businesses modernize operations, develop digital products and manage technology infrastructure. Its services include consulting, application development and management, cloud computing, cybersecurity, data and analytics, artificial intelligence, engineering, and business process services.
 The company serves clients across industries including financial services, healthcare, consumer and retail, communications, energy, manufacturing, and technology. Recommended Stories
